fields.name: Data
fields.evidence: Windows reader bg3.exe+0x1BB9E30 (client visual/cloth setup): when the visual has cloth (flags at Visual+0xF6 & 3) it fetches this component (getter bg3.exe+0x1BBA700) and passes its 8-byte value as a pointer (falling back to the static DAT_146179888 when the entity has no component) to the phx::NVClothScene method bg3.exe+0x3A67180, which reads 12 bytes through it (*p as 8 bytes, p[1] as 4 bytes - a vec3-sized record) into the cloth instance it creates. macOS: AddComponent<ls::ClothTeleportDataComponent, ls::ClothTeleportData&> - the component holds an 8-byte ls::ClothTeleportData. Live: addresses inside the executable image (static records), not heap.

summary: Client cloth: marks that an entity's cloth must be reset after a teleport (position jump), carrying an 8-byte ls::ClothTeleportData; seen in dialogues and fights (characters placed by timelines).
open_questions: What the pointed-to 12-byte record is (a teleport offset vec3 by its size) and which static the live pointers target.
second_pass: Windows bg3.exe+0x1BB9E30 dereferences the component's 8 bytes as a pointer to a 12-byte record handed to the NVCloth scene (bg3.exe+0x3A67180), with a static default when absent: the member is a pointer, width and offset established.
